sloka: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः ।भवत्याहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ।। ५.६८.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṁ mahātmanaḥ ।bhavatyāhavaśūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya ।। 5.68.15 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You may make arrangement in such a way that the exalted hero Rama exhibits his might according to his stature'.
